# Chess Opening Coach Skill for Muse

Builds you a small, coherent chess opening repertoire fitted to your style and rating: one main choice for White, answers for Black against 1.e4 and 1.d4, sized to what you can actually learn. It teaches the ideas behind the lines — pawn breaks, piece placement, typical plans — not just moves to memorize, plus the common traps to know from both sides and what to study next. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is a study and coaching skill — it prepares your repertoire and explains ideas, it doesn't play moves for you or connect to a chess engine. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
